ArchetypeDataBlock.PublicName: The name of the archetype as it will appear in the game. This is the more generic name, e.g., "Assault Rifle". Can be a persistentID to a TextDataBlock block, or a raw string.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Description: The weapon description as displayed in the lobby. Can be a persistentID to a TextDataBlock block, or a raw string.
ArchetypeDataBlock.FireMode: Firing mode of the weapon, affects which other fields are used in this block.
ArchetypeDataBlock.RecoilDataID: The recoil data for this weapon.
ArchetypeDataBlock.DamageBoosterEffect: Which booster types should affect this weapon.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Damage: The base damage of this weapon.
ArchetypeDataBlock.DamageFalloff: Linear damage falloff for this weapon. X is the falloff start, Y is the falloff end. Minimum value is 0.1x the base damage.
ArchetypeDataBlock.StaggerDamageMulti: Stagger damage multiplier for the base damage.
ArchetypeDataBlock.PrecisionDamageMulti: Precision damage multiplier for the base damage.
ArchetypeDataBlock.DefaultClipSize: Default magazine size for this weapon. Can be affected by GearMagPartDataBlock.
ArchetypeDataBlock.DefaultReloadTime: Time (seconds) for the reload animation to complete. Can be affected by GearMagPartDataBlock.
ArchetypeDataBlock.CostOfBullet: Used with PlayerDataBlock ammo values to several weapon ammo values. Determines the starting ammo, max reserve ammo, and how much ammo an ammo pack will give. Check the wiki for detailed information.
ArchetypeDataBlock.ShotDelay: Time in seconds between shots. Sentries don't immediately detect that an enemy died, so they are more likely to waste ammo on dead enemies when this delay is low.
ArchetypeDataBlock.PiercingBullets: True if this weapon can pierce. Note this is broken for shotgun sentries.
ArchetypeDataBlock.PiercingDamageCountLimit: How many enemies a piercing bullet can hit. 1 means it will not pierce. 5 is technically max. This is buggy and you may not get all the pierce you are promised.
ArchetypeDataBlock.HipFireSpread: Hipfire random spread. Lower values are more accurate. A weapon with 1 spread is fairly accurate even at mid-long range, 0 spread is fully accurate.
ArchetypeDataBlock.AimSpread: ADS random spread. Lower values are more accurate. A weapon with 1 spread is fairly accurate even at mid-long range, 0 spread is fully accurate.
ArchetypeDataBlock.EquipTransitionTime: How long the equip animation takes. Effects when it can be fired after selecting. Only actually delays the swap by half the value, and it can be skipped by ADSing
ArchetypeDataBlock.EquipSequence: Animation sequence to play when equipping this weapon.
ArchetypeDataBlock.AimTransitionTime: How long the ADS animation takes.
ArchetypeDataBlock.AimSequence: Animation sequence to play when aiming with a weapon.
ArchetypeDataBlock.BurstDelay: For burst weapons, delay between separate bursts.
ArchetypeDataBlock.BurstShotCount: For burst weapons, how many shots in a single burst.
ArchetypeDataBlock.ShotgunBulletCount: For shotguns, how many pellets per shot.
ArchetypeDataBlock.ShotgunConeSize: The cone size of the shotgun. Determines how much the bullets can spread.
ArchetypeDataBlock.ShotgunBulletSpread: Shotgun random pellet spread. Needs a whole number. Does not scale well with cone size and can result in shots going way further from the middle than expected.
ArchetypeDataBlock.SpecialChargetupTime: How long it takes for the weapon to charge before firing. Yes, they fucked up the spelling.
ArchetypeDataBlock.SpecialCooldownTime: Delay before a weapon can charge up again when it stops firing. Currently broken for auto weapons.
ArchetypeDataBlock.SpecialSemiBurstCountTimeout: Time for the semiburst weapon shot count to reset.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_StartFireDelay: Delay before a sentry starts firing after detecting an enemy.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_DetectionMaxAngle: Max angle to either side at which a sentry can detect humans. Any value above 90 (180 degrees vision) will not work as they cannot physically turn around unless FireTowardsTargetInsteadOfForward is enabled.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_FireTowardsTargetInsteadOfForward: True if the sentry should have aimbot.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_LegacyEnemyDetection: True if the sentry should use the legacy enemy detection system. Generally works, but can be buggy with many targets in the detection range. If false, has issues seeing through doorways.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_FireTagOnly: True if the sentry should only target biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_PrioTag: True if the sentry should prioritise targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_StartFireDelayTagMulti: A firing delay multiplier when targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_RotationSpeedTagMulti: A rotation speed multiplier when targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_StaggerDamageTagMulti: A stagger damage multiplier when targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_CostOfBulletTagMulti: A CostOfBullet multiplier when targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.
ArchetypeDataBlock.Sentry_ShotDelayTagMulti: A shot delay multiplier when targeting biotracker-tagged enemies.

EnemyGroupDataBlock.Roles: List of roles for this group. Each role will spawn one type of enemy when this group is selected.
EnemyGroupDataBlock.Roles.Role: The role match of this enemy. This is used alongside the group's Difficulty to match to an EnemyPopulationDataBlock block.
EnemyGroupDataBlock.Roles.Distribution: Multiplier for MaxScore, setting how much score this role will get. Affects how many enemies will spawn. E.g., Rel_50 and MaxScore 10 will mean 5 total score, so will be able to spawn five 1.0-cost enemies.

EnemyMovementDataBlock.ForceDisableAnimator: Whether to forcefully disable the animator on this enemy.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.AnimationControllers: A comma+space-separated list of the internal animation controllers used for this enemy.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.MoveSlowerWhenInPlayerRoom: True if this enemy should move slower when in the player's room.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.MoveSlowerWithinTargetDistance: If this enemy is within this distance from the player, then they will move more slowly.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.GlobalAnimSpeedMulti: A multiplier for the animation speed of this enemy.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.PathMoveAnimSpeedMulti: A multiplier for the path move animation speed of this enemy.
EnemyMovementDataBlock.AllowClimbDownLadders: True if this enemy should be able to climb ladders.

EnemyPopulationDataBlock.RoleDatas: The role datas for this population block. This is used for mapping role+difficulty matches to enemies.
EnemyPopulationDataBlock.RoleDatas.Enemy: The enemy to map this Role+Difficulty to.
EnemyPopulationDataBlock.RoleDatas.Cost: The cost of this enemy in the match. Affects how many enemies will spawn when this entry is selected based on the MaxScore in the EnemyGroupDataBlock that matched to this.
EnemyPopulationDataBlock.RoleDatas.Weight: Relative weight of this entry. Affects how likely it is to be selected when several are matched.

ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.HealthPerZone: A multiplier for the health of this expedition. All HealthMultis in other datablocks (most notably, LevelLayoutDataBlock) are multiplied by this value before being used. Would recommend setting this to 1.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.DisinfectionPerZone: A multiplier for the disinfection of this expedition. All DisinfectionMultis in other datablocks (most notably, LevelLayoutDataBlock) are multiplied by this value before being used. Would recommend setting this to 1.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeaponAmmoPerZone: A multiplier for the ammo of this expedition. All WeaponAmmoMultis in other datablocks (most notably, LevelLayoutDataBlock) are multiplied by this value before being used. Would recommend setting this to 1.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ToolAmmoPerZone: A multiplier for the tool of this expedition. All ToolAmmoMultis in other datablocks (most notably, LevelLayoutDataBlock) are multiplied by this value before being used. Would recommend setting this to 1.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ChanceToPutCommodityInResourceContainer: The chance 0-1 to put a commodity (decoration) in a resource container.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ChanceToPutArtifactInResourceContainer: The chance 0-1 to put a random artifact in a resource container.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ChanceToSpawnCommodityLargePack: The chance 0-1 to spawn large commodities (decorations) in a resource container.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ChanceToSpawnCommodityMediumPack: The chance 0-1 to spawn medium commodities (decorations) in a resource container.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ChanceToReUseResourceContainer: The chance 0-1 to put new loot spawns in an existing resource container instead of making a new one. Higher chances will make cause there to be less boxes/lockers but each of them will have more loot in them on average.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.MaxPacksPerResourceContainer: The maximum number of packs that can spawn in a resource container.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.EmptyWeakResourceContainersPerZone: The number of empty weak resource containers to spawn in each zone.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.EmptySecureResourceContainersPerZone: The number of empty secure resource containers to spawn in each zone.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.TerminalsPerZone: The number of terminals to expect in each zone. They must still be added manually in the LevelLayoutDataBlock.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.ArtifactsPerLayer: The number of artifacts to spawn in each layer.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoor4x4Health: The health of a small (4x4) door.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoor8x4Health: The health of a long (8x4) door.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoorChanceLockWeightNoLock: The probability weight for a weak door to have no lock on it.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoorChanceLockWeightMeleeLock: The probability weight for a weak door to have a padlock (smack lock) on it.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoorChanceLockWeightHackableLock: The probability weight for a weak door to have a hack lock on it.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoorUnlockedChanceForOpen: The chance 0-1 for a weak door to already be open when it is unlocked.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakDoorLockHealth: The HP of a smack lock. Affected by the environmental multipliers on melee weapons.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.WeakResourceContainerWithPackChanceForLo: The chance 0-1 that a resource container that has a pack inside it will be locked.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.GlueVolumeToDoorHealthConversion: The conversion factor for the volume of glue to the health of a door. E.g., if this value is 0.5, and there are 10 units of C-Foam, then the door will have 5 extra health.
ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock.GlueVolumeForDoorGlueMaxState: The maximum glue volume that a door can have.

FlashlightSettingsDataBlock.range: The visible range of the flashlight.
FlashlightSettingsDataBlock.angle: The angle of the flashlight cone.
FlashlightSettingsDataBlock.intensity: The intensity of the flashlight beam.
FlashlightSettingsDataBlock.color: The RGBA color of the flashlight.

FogSettingsDataBlock.FogColor: The RGBA color of the fog. Non-white fog may not block sight very well, and colours may be affected by other factors in the environment.
FogSettingsDataBlock.FogDensity: The base fog density in the entire level. To create inverted fog as in R5E1, you have to set FogDensity and DensityHeightMaxBoost such that FogDensity < DensityHeightMaxBoost. This value is normally very low - most vanilla settings have less than 0.001.
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityNoiseDirection: Noise are the floating particles right above the fog plane. This field is a vector that controls the floating direction of those particles.
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityNoiseSpread: Controls how fast noise particles float, and how uneven the pattern of the fog plane is. Most vanilla settings use a value less than 0.1.
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityNoiseScale: Controls the size of the noise particles. Most vanilla settings use a value around 0.1.
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityHeightAltitude: The lowest point for the fog height. For non-inversed fog (R5E1), everything with altitude lower than this value will be fully submerged by the fog. Normal zone altitudes - Low: -4.0, Mid: 0.0, High: 4.0
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityHeightRange: Distance above the lowest point for fog height, used in calculating the highest point for fog height.
FogSettingsDataBlock.DensityHeightMaxBoost: Actual field for controlling the density of non-inversed fog (R5E1). The larger, the more occluding. R5D2, a level with very dense fog, uses a value of 0.2.
FogSettingsDataBlock.Infection: The maximum value for how fast infection accumulates from fog. For exmaple, 0.1 would take you 10% infected per second. 0.03 is a common value to set this to. Note that the infection speed is based on how deep you are in the fog with linear scaling. The lowest infection gain rate is at DensityHeightAltitude + DensityHeightRange, and the lowest point is at DensityHeightAltitude.

GameSetupDataBlock.RundownIdsToLoad: List of the rundowns to load, as a list of rundown IDs. If making a rundown, this needs to be used to make your rundown accessible. If only one rundown is provided, then the rundown selection screen is skipped.

LevelLayoutDataBlock.ZoneAliasStart: The start value for the zone numbers. Zones are offset by their local indexes to get the final value.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.name: Internal name for this level layout. It is recommended to name this something meaningful.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.persistentID: ID of this level layout. Must be unique.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LocalIndex: Internal name for the zone. The elevator zone should be 0.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasOverride: Override for the zone's number. -1 for no override.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.OverrideAliasPrefix: true if the alias prefix override should be used.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasPrefixOverride: The prefix before the zone number. A common use case is to name this something like "Resource Room, ZONE". Only active if OverrideAliasPrefix is true.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasPrefixShortOverride: The short prefix before the zone's number (typically, 'Z').
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.SubSeed: Subseed for the zone. Most notably, determines which rooms will be generated - change this to get different rooms.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.MarkerSubSeed: Subseed used for the markers within the zone's rooms. Determines what markers (objects) generate within rooms - change this to get different markers.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LightsSubSeed: Subseed used for the lights to determine how the lights will be generated based on the assigned LightSettings.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.BulkheadDCScanSeed: Subseed used foro determining where bulkhead DC scans will be placed (if present).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.SubComplex: Determines the tileset to be used for this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.CoverageMinMax: The minimum and maximum coverage values for the zone. Smaller values will result in smaller zones.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.BuildFromLocalIndex: The index of the zone where this zone comes from.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartPosition: Where in the source zone to try to make the entrance to this zone. Will be ignored if the door is unable to be generated here.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartPosition_IndexWeight: Value from 0-1 used to determine which room to build the zone from. For a zone with 5 rooms, a value of 0.4 will try to build from room B.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartExpansion: Towards which direction the source zone will be. This direction is global - forward is looking forward from the elevator, etc.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ZoneExpansion: How the zone should expand. Collapsed tries to take up as little space as possible, expansional does the opposite.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LightSettings: The light settings to use for this zone, as a block from the LightSettingsDataBlock.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AltitudeData: The desired height of the zone. Does not make a difference for starting areas of the level/dimension.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AltitudeData.AllowedZoneAltitude: The altitude(s) at which this zone will generate rooms.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AltitudeData.ChanceToChange: The 0-1 chance that the altitude will chance between different rooms in this zone.
